issue_context.title: Attempt to subtract with overflow on negative slice in Parquet
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

On a debug build:
```python
import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({"x": 1})
df.write_parquet(".env/data.parquet")
print(pl.scan_parquet(".env/data.parquet").slice(-99, 1).collect())

```


### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

Regression by https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/17972

### Expected behavior

```python
>>> df.slice(-99, 1)
shape: (0, 1)
┌─────┐
│ x   │
│ --- │
│ i64 │
╞═════╡
└─────┘
```

### Installed versions

main / 1.4.0
